ideas.title: Uncovering Systemic Issues in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the root causes of the multiple federal investigations in Minnesota, including the Nolan Wells case and the Minnesota immigration crackdown
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the connections between entities
questions: What are the underlying causes of the federal investigations in Minnesota?
How are the different investigations connected?
ideas.insight: The multiple federal investigations in Minnesota suggest a deeper problem that requires a thorough examination of the connections between entities and the flow of money.
